item.title: Understanding the Double Entry System of Accounting with Local Government Examples
item.description:
Understanding the Double Entry System of Accounting with Local Government Examples

Accounting is the language of finance. Whether it is a business, a municipality, or a village panchayat, every financial transaction must be recorded accurately. The Double Entry System of Accounting is the most widely accepted method of recording financial transactions because it ensures accuracy, transparency, and accountability.

This article explains the fundamentals of the double-entry system in simple language and illustrates it with practical examples from local governments such as Gram Panchayats, Municipalities, and Urban Local Bodies.

item.title: Compilation of Acts, Rules and Provisions: Building a Comprehensive Guide to Sikkim Local Fund Audit
item.description:
Compilation of Acts, Rules and Provisions: Building a Comprehensive Guide to Sikkim Local Fund Audit

Introduction

Government auditing plays a vital role in ensuring transparency, accountability, and proper utilization of public funds. Auditors, government officials, elected representatives, researchers, and students often need to refer to numerous Acts, Rules, Notifications, Government Orders, Circulars, and Guidelines while conducting or understanding audits.

Unfortunately, these documents are usually scattered across different departments, websites, notifications, and printed publications. Finding the correct legal provision during an audit often becomes time-consuming.
